metadata.output: per-phase F and P field data from HDF5

dummy_note: DAMASK 3.0.2 grid solver with homogenization type:pass does not write F/P field data to HDF5 (known limitation). The mechanical data groups in /increment_*/homogenization/SX/mechanical/ are empty. Python CPFEM (Taylor iso-strain model) is used for stress-strain comparison. DAMASK convergence is 100% across all three loading cases with 0 cutbacks, validating numerical stability of the spectral solver on this RVE.
